source.description: Automatisch umgewandelt aus der MusicXML-Datei „Das-newgebohrne-kindelein-buxtehude.mxl“ der CPDL-Seite „Das neugebohrne Kindelein, BuxWV 13 (Dietrich Buxtehude)“ mit tools/liedquellen/cpdl_import.py. Nicht gegen die Vorlage geprüft. Hinweis der Ausgabe: Some files contain a cover page. If you print double-sided, you can use this to create a booklet. With an even number of pages of sheet music, this means that two pages of sheet music are always next to each other, reducing the number of times you need to turn the page. If you don't need the cover page, you can simply leave it out. The piano reduction is generated automatically and contains only the voices for violin1+2 and organon as instrumental voices .
